projects.intervention_detail: Beetroot-juice nitrate concentrate, 400 mg (6.45 mM) each morning for a 5-day treatment week in healthy volunteers, with saliva/taste assessment before, during and after.

papers.title: Nitrate supplementation affects taste by changing the oral metabolome and microbiome.
Suprathreshold non-volatile flavour perception is associated with multiple species rather than any single species via bacterial metabolism.

projects.title: Nitrate affect taste
